environment.description: Kubernetes deployment where the worker pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volume mounts are defined for the /var/lib/worker/status path. The container image uses a distroless base with no shell. Pod runs under a PodSecurityPolicy (legacy cluster v1.24) that enforces readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and disallows privilege escalation. The Celery worker process runs as UID 65534 (nobody). Note: the /tmp directory is NOT mounted as tmpfs — there are no writable mount points in the container at all. Redis connection uses TLS mutual auth with cert rotation via cert-manager.

config.network_policy: allow egress to redis only on port 6380/TLS
